Our personalised pop figure word art print is a fun gift for fans of Disney: a mermaid princess pop figure in red and pink inspired by Ariel, built from a name and your words.

Create a personalised pop figure word art print in two boxes

Fill in two boxes: the name, which sits once prominently in the design, and your word list of 20 to 30 words separated by commas, such as nicknames, hobbies, friends and favourite things. We repeat the words randomly in different sizes, fonts and shades across the figure, and the preview shows what you've typed next to the print photo.

Short words work best. We print exactly what you type, so check the spelling.

Why you'll love it

  • The name stands out once, and your other words repeat in different sizes, fonts and shades
  • High-quality full-colour print, made to order
  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames

Size & details

  • Design: a mermaid princess pop figure in red and pink, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Posted the next working day (same day if you order before 12pm) by Royal Mail. A fun personalised gift for a fan's birthday or Christmas.

Please note

This is an unofficial design inspired by Disney's Ariel, drawn in the style of collectable pop vinyl figures. It is not official merchandise and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or connected with Disney, The Walt Disney Company or Funko, or any of their licensees. All names, characters and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Got someone who lives for their hobby? This personalised ballet word art print shows a ballerina on pointe in grey, with the name in pink, made from their name and the words that describe them. A thoughtful present for a club mate, coach or proud parent.

Make your own personalised ballet word art print

Type the name in the first box; it appears once, in pride of place. In the second box, type 20 to 30 words separated by commas: club names, places, friends and the words their mates use about them. We repeat them in different sizes, fonts and shades to fill the design. The preview shows your details before you add it to your basket.

Single words work best, and no phrase should be longer than three words. Check the spelling carefully, as we print exactly what you enter. Icons, emoji and accents can't be included.

Why you'll love it

  • High-quality full-colour print, made to order
  • Four print-only sizes, from a shelf-sized A4 to a statement A1
  • Ready to display: A3 frames have a clip on the back for hanging, and A4 frames have a stand
  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames

Size & details

  • Design: a ballerina on pointe in grey, with the name in pink, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised ballet word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.

Great for a birthday, a club presentation or an end-of-season thank you.
